name: Brew at the Zoo
description: 61 quests for a night of craft beer, wild animals, and better stories. Photos make the scrapbook — points are just the seasoning.

quests.title: Red panda paparazzi
quests.description: Photo with a red panda. Bonus swagger if it's mid-yawn.

quests.title: The big cat stare-down
quests.description: Photo of a big cat looking directly at the camera.

quests.title: Flamingo formation
quests.description: Photo of you copying a flamingo's pose. One leg. Commit.

quests.title: Loudest animal on record
quests.description: Video or photo of the loudest animal you can find. Note what it sounded like.

quests.title: Sleepy silhouette
quests.description: Photo of an animal fully, gloriously asleep.

quests.title: Feeding time frenzy
quests.description: Catch any animal mid-snack.

quests.title: Tiny but mighty
quests.description: Photo of the smallest animal you can find tonight.

quests.title: The underdog exhibit
quests.description: Visit the exhibit with no crowd around it and photograph its resident. They deserve fans too.

quests.title: Reptile respect
quests.description: Photo with a reptile. Note its name if it has one posted.

quests.title: Bird of the night
quests.description: Photograph a bird and give it a dramatic nickname in your note.

quests.title: Spirit animal, found
quests.description: Photo of the animal that is most You tonight. Explain in the note.

quests.title: Nocturnal neighbors
quests.description: Photograph any nocturnal animal actually being awake.

quests.title: The judgment face
quests.description: Photo of an animal that appears to be judging your beverage choices.

quests.title: Primate parallel
quests.description: Photo of a primate and a friend making the same face.

quests.title: First pour
quests.description: Photo of your first beer of the night, held high.

quests.title: Never had it, trying it
quests.description: Try a beer style you've never had. Note the style and a one-word review.

quests.title: ABV oracle
quests.description: Guess a beer's ABV within 1% before checking. A friend must witness.

quests.title: The hometown pour
quests.description: Find and try a beer from the brewery closest to your hometown.

quests.title: Darkest in the house
quests.description: Track down the darkest beer being poured tonight. Photo of the pour.

quests.title: Sour face
quests.description: Try a sour and have a friend photograph your first-sip face.

quests.title: Brewer chat
quests.description: Talk to someone pouring and learn one fact about their brewery. Note the fact.

quests.title: The perfect pairing
quests.description: Declare a beer + animal pairing, e.g. 'this stout pairs with the black bear.' Photo of both.

quests.title: Cheers around the ring
quests.description: Photo of at least four cups mid-clink.

quests.title: Style detective
quests.description: Correctly identify a beer's style from a blind sip a friend hands you.

quests.title: Water break hero
quests.description: Photo of you drinking water like a responsible legend. Hydration is a quest.

quests.title: Label art critic
quests.description: Photo of the best can/tap art you find, with a one-line art review.

quests.title: Three-friend selfie
quests.description: Get 3 friends in one selfie. Everyone visible, no exceptions.

quests.title: New friend protocol
quests.description: Meet someone outside your group and get a photo together. Note their name.

quests.title: Group jump shot
quests.description: Everyone airborne at once. Attempts count; note how many tries it took.

quests.title: The reunion hug
quests.description: Photograph two friends hugging like they haven't seen each other in years.

quests.title: Compliment cascade
quests.description: Give 3 genuine compliments to 3 different people. A friend verifies.

quests.title: Matching energy
quests.description: Photo with a stranger who is dressed remarkably like you or your friend.

quests.title: The toast
quests.description: Give a toast to the group, minimum 15 seconds. A friend verifies it happened.

quests.title: Dance floor pioneer
quests.description: Be dancing before at least 5 other people are. Photographic proof.

quests.title: Story swap
quests.description: Trade an embarrassing story with a friend. Write down the title of theirs (just the title).

quests.title: Photographer's eye
quests.description: Take a genuinely great candid photo of a friend and let them approve it.

quests.title: Squad establishing shot
quests.description: Full group photo in front of the event entrance or sign.

quests.title: The wingperson
quests.description: Introduce two people who haven't met. Photo of the introduction.

quests.title: Animal impression open mic
quests.description: Perform your best animal impression for the group. Video or witnessed.

quests.title: The dramatic reenactment
quests.description: Reenact an animal's behavior you witnessed tonight. Photo mid-performance.

quests.title: Walk this way
quests.description: Cross an open area walking like a penguin. Full commitment required.

quests.title: Invisible enclosure
quests.description: Photo of you posed as an exhibit, with a friend reading your imaginary info placard.

quests.title: The nature documentary
quests.description: Narrate a friend's ordinary actions in a hushed documentary voice for 30 seconds.

quests.title: Mascot moment
quests.description: Photo with any mascot, statue, or oversized animal decoration.

quests.title: Face paint or bust
quests.description: Draw whiskers on yourself or a willing friend. Photo of the result.

quests.title: The slow-motion entrance
quests.description: Film the group doing a slow-motion movie entrance walk.

quests.title: Pun-ishment
quests.description: Land three animal puns in normal conversation without acknowledging them. A friend keeps count.

quests.title: Statue challenge
quests.description: Hold perfectly still next to a statue until a stranger does a double take.

quests.title: Headcount oracle
quests.description: Guess how many people are at the event within 50. Check with staff or signage if posted.

quests.title: Species census
quests.description: Guess how many animal species this zoo houses, then find the real number posted somewhere.

quests.title: The lifespan gamble
quests.description: Pick an animal, guess its average lifespan, then check the placard. Within 5 years wins.

quests.title: Weight class
quests.description: Guess an animal's weight before reading its placard. Within 20% wins.

quests.title: Founded when?
quests.description: Guess the year this zoo opened, then verify. Within a decade wins.

quests.title: Taps tally
quests.description: Guess the total number of breweries pouring tonight before counting them.

quests.title: The collective noun quiz
quests.description: Stump a friend with a real collective noun (a shadow of jaguars, a flamboyance of flamingos). Note which one you used.

quests.title: Closing time prophecy
quests.description: Before 9pm, predict which friend will be the last one to leave. Seal it in your note; check it at the end.

quests.title: The Golden Hour
quests.description: LEGENDARY: Assemble your entire group for one photo in golden light — sunset, string lights, or lantern glow. This is next year's throwback photo. Make it count.

quests.title: The Zookeeper's Secret
quests.description: LEGENDARY: Learn something from a staff member that isn't posted on any placard, and write it down for the scrapbook.

quests.title: The Grand Tour
quests.description: LEGENDARY: Visit every open exhibit zone tonight. Photo at the farthest one as proof.

quests.title: The Time Capsule Photo
quests.description: LEGENDARY: Stage a photo you'll recreate exactly at next year's event. Same people, same spot, same pose.

quests.title: The Founder's Toast
quests.description: LEGENDARY: Gather everyone, raise a glass, and toast to the person who organized tonight. Someone films it.
